provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: BANG! The Duel rulebook (dV Giochi, via RulesPal)

steps.text: One player is the Law, the other the Outlaws; keep the summary cards handy
Shuffle your 12 Characters facedown, draw {n} at random, box the rest
steps.note: Draw more for a longer game

steps.text: Look at them, shuffle facedown into your reserve pile
Draw 2 from the reserve; choose your Active Character secretly, then both reveal and place the AC token
Reveal the other as your Rearguard Character next to the AC
Matching bullet tokens on each character; leftover bullets in the middle
Shuffle your 40-card deck facedown in front of you
Starting hands: the Law draws 4, the Outlaws draw 5
Both players share one discard pile
